description:
About the Position

TU Delft invites applications for a PhD position on the twin transition of infrastructure, focusing on paradoxical leadership, funded through an NWO Vidi project. The research examines how organisations that plan and govern infrastructure face simultaneous digital and sustainability transitions - two agendas that can reinforce each other but also create tensions between competing priorities, timelines and values. The doctoral project studies how leaders navigate these paradoxes in infrastructure organisations, combining organisational theory with empirical fieldwork among infrastructure managers and policymakers.

The position sits within the university's infrastructure and organisation research environment, connecting public-management scholarship with engineering-facing questions about how Dutch and European infrastructure systems change. The PhD candidate will design interviews and case studies, analyse leadership practices and contribute to international publications and practitioner-oriented outputs. The appointment follows the Dutch CAO-NU collective agreement with a starting salary of EUR 3,204 per month, growing with seniority.

Candidate Profile and Supervision

Applicants hold a research master's degree in management, organisation studies, public administration, engineering management or a related discipline, with strong qualitative research skills and an interest in infrastructure and sustainability governance. Experience with interviewing and case-study methods is an advantage, as is affinity with digitalisation or sustainability themes. The candidate works under the supervision of the Vidi project leader within an active group of doctoral researchers and benefits from TU Delft's graduate school training programme.

Highlights

  • NWO Vidi-funded PhD on paradoxical leadership in infrastructure transitions
  • Digital plus sustainability twin-transition research agenda
  • Qualitative case studies with infrastructure organisations
  • Salaried under the CAO-NU agreement (EUR 3,204 - 4,051 per month)
  • Delft graduate school training and international collaboration
  • Four-year doctoral appointment
